digest.component_or_area: janitor plan recovery and approval workflow
propositions: Recovered 2026-08-16 janitor plan contains approved-but-lossy RP-02 through RP-06 decisions requiring evidence-backed discussions and recovery-authority validation before becoming implementation stories

Each RP requires a decision-ready brief mapping architectural intent, hard-won behavior, edge cases, implementation seams, migration hazards, and remaining maintainer choices, verified against source, tests, and historical tickets
All substantive claims must cite repository, tracker, history, test, or maintained-project evidence with explicit marking of any behavior deltas for maintainer approval

Cross-RP dependencies and mutual implementation boundaries (RP-02 transaction semantics, RP-03 retry ownership, RP-04 operation snapshot, RP-05 CLI registry, RP-06 effective policy) must be finalized before cutover to prevent silent compatibility breaks
